title: Citations of "There's Plenty of Room at the Bottom" in the scientific literature, by period
description: Bar chart. Citations of Feynman's talk found by Chris Toumey in the Science Citation Index: 3 in the 1960s, 4 in the 1970s, and 63 in the thirteen years after Drexler's 1981 paper. Data: Chris Toumey, Apostolic Succession, Engineering & Science 68, no. 1/2 (2005).
heading: CITATIONS OF "PLENTY OF ROOM"
